DANCE_CONTENT.BALLET: Ballet is a classical form of dance based on strict technique, harmony of movement, and expressiveness, combining music and theatre.
DANCE_CONTENT.MODERN_MUSICAL: Modern dance is a style of dance that developed as a reaction against classical ballet.
DANCE_CONTENT.CONTEMPORARY: Contemporary dance is a style of dance that emphasises freedom of movement and personal expression.
DANCE_CONTENT.MUSIC_MOVEMENT: Music and movement education is a teaching method that combines music and movement, helping children express themselves creatively.
DANCE_CONTENT.BALLET_WORKOUT: A fitness class inspired by ballet, with strength and conditioning work at the barre and on the floor.

DANCE_ABOUT.BALLET:
Ballet is the art of harmony, precision, and expression. Through the discipline of movement and the power of music, the body gains lightness, balance, and grace.

Beyond technique, ballet cultivates focus, sensitivity, and self-confidence, creating a unique way of communicating and expressing oneself.

A journey where every movement gains meaning and every step becomes part of a distinctive story.
DANCE_ABOUT.MUSIC_MOVEMENT:
Music and movement education is children's first, beautiful introduction to the world of music and dance. Through play, music, and movement, children explore their bodies, rhythm, and space, while developing their imagination and creativity.

Through simple and enjoyable activities, they gradually come into contact with the first elements of dance, cultivating coordination, balance, body awareness, and expression.

A first journey into the world of dance, full of music, play, and smiles.
DANCE_ABOUT.MODERN_MUSICAL:
Modern dance combines the dynamism of movement with freedom of expression, drawing inspiration from various street and urban dance styles, with strong hip hop elements.

Through dynamic choreography, rhythm, and musicality, students develop coordination, physical strength, self-confidence, and stage presence.

A dance full of energy, personality, and rhythm, where technique meets creativity and every movement takes on its own character.
DANCE_ABOUT.CONTEMPORARY:
Contemporary dance is a form of expression born from freedom of movement, music, and emotion. With an emphasis on naturalness, flow, and the body's dynamics, it gives every dancer room to discover their own way of expressing themselves.

Through technique, improvisation, and the exploration of movement, dancers cultivate body awareness, flexibility, strength, and creativity.

A journey of freedom and personal expression, where the body moves, feels, and tells its own story.
DANCE_ABOUT.BALLET_WORKOUT:
Ballet Workout combines the elegance and precision of ballet with a complete full-body conditioning program. Through simplified exercises and movements inspired by classical ballet technique, the body grows stronger, more toned, and gains better posture and flexibility.

A class accessible to everyone, with no prior ballet experience required, offering a unique blend of exercise, music, and grace.

For a strong, harmonious, and well-defined body, through the aesthetics of dance.

PILATES_CONTENT.MAT: Pilates Mat is the form of Pilates performed on a mat, using body weight as the main resistance.
PILATES_CONTENT.REFORMER: Pilates Reformer is a form of Pilates performed on a special apparatus with springs, pulleys, and a moving platform.

DANCE_LIST_PAGE.HEADING: Five classes, from first steps to the stage
DANCE_LIST_PAGE.DESCRIPTION: Everyone starts somewhere. Try any class once for free, and we'll tell you honestly which group you belong in — including the adult ones, where nobody has danced before.
DANCE_LIST_PAGE.NOT_SURE_BODY: Tell us the age and we'll suggest two to sit in on. No obligation, and the first class you join is free.
DANCE_LIST_PAGE.ALSO_BODY: Most of the adult dancers here do one Pilates class a week. Groups of eight on the mat, four on the reformers.

PILATES_PAGE.HEADING: Strength that a dancer would recognise
PILATES_PAGE.DESCRIPTION: Both practices come out of the same idea: control before effort. Mat classes cap at eight; the reformer room takes four, so the springs and the cueing are yours.
PILATES_PAGE.STEPS_HEADING: How the first month usually goes
PILATES_PAGE.STEP_1_BODY: Fifty minutes on the reformer, one to one, so we know your history.
PILATES_PAGE.STEP_2_BODY: Usually one mat, one reformer. Anything else is a bonus.
PILATES_PAGE.STEP_3_HEADING: We check in at week four
PILATES_PAGE.STEP_3_BODY: Adjust the plan, or add a dance class if you've caught the bug.
